answer: Robots that wander between a tundra depot and an orchard rely on emergency relays. A shutdown needs signatures from three licensed dispatch operators. A regulator verifies beneficial control and certifies each operator key and control group. Relays check current permits and count each group once per fresh command. A hundred aliases add no approval beyond their owner. Capture needs three groups' keys or a corrupt registry. Honest operators disclose ownership, and hidden control can defeat the check.
